data.title: Explore Our Solar System
data.description: Join us on a journey to discover the wonderful worlds that travel through space around our Sun. Let us look closely at how these celestial neighbors move and what makes each one unique.

bodies.name: Sun
bodies.description: The Sun is our star! It is a giant ball of hot gas that gives us light and warmth.
bodies.funFact: The Sun is so big that over 1 million Earths could fit inside it!

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.description: Mercury is a rocky world with lots of craters on its surface.
bodies.funFact: Mercury zips around the Sun in just 88 days.

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: Venus is covered in thick clouds that trap heat very effectively.
bodies.funFact: A day on Venus is longer than its year!

bodies.name: Earth
bodies.description: Earth is our home! It is the only known world with liquid water on the surface and abundant life.
bodies.funFact: Earth is the only planet not named after a god or goddess.

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: Mars has enormous volcanoes and deep canyons waiting to be explored.
bodies.funFact: Mars looks red because its soil contains rusty iron.

bodies.name: Jupiter
bodies.description: Jupiter is a massive gassy world featuring swirling cloud bands and a persistent great storm.
bodies.funFact: Jupiter has dozens of moons orbiting along with it!

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.description: Saturn is a gas giant surrounded by a magnificent system of wide rings.
bodies.funFact: Saturn is so light it could float in water if you had a big enough ocean.

bodies.name: Uranus
bodies.description: Uranus is an icy world that tilts intensely as it travels on its path.
bodies.funFact: Uranus rolls around the Sun like a ball instead of spinning like a top.

bodies.name: Neptune
bodies.description: Neptune is a deep blue dynamic world with powerful weather systems.
bodies.funFact: Neptune experiences some of the most intense winds in the entire solar system.

bodies.name: Pluto
bodies.description: Pluto is a small, distant icy world located far out in the outer realms.
bodies.funFact: Pluto has a distinctive heart-shaped region on its icy surface.
